cases.sentence: ___ был из толстой как лубок бумаги.
cases.translation: The envelope was made of paper as thick as cardboard.
cases.explain: «Конверт» is the grammatical subject of «был», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.translation: I am unhappy from being separated from my son.
cases.explain: The preposition «от» governs the Genitive case: «от разлуки».

cases.sentence: Графиня Лидия Ивановна писала обыкновенно по две и по три записки в день Алексею ___.
cases.translation: Countess Lidia Ivanovna usually wrote two or three notes a day to Alexei Alexandrovich.
cases.explain: The verb «писать кому» governs the Dative case: «писала Алексею Александровичу».

cases.sentence: Она не хотела заставить страдать этого великодушного ___ воспоминанием о себе.
cases.translation: She did not want to make this generous man suffer by reminding him of herself.
cases.explain: «Человека» is the direct object of «заставить», hence Accusative (identical to the Genitive form for an animate masculine noun).

cases.sentence: Когда муж встречался с женою, то всегда относился к ней с неизменной ядовитой ___.
cases.translation: When her husband met his wife, he always treated her with the same venomous mockery.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the Instrumental case: «с насмешкой».

cases.sentence: Эта ужасная женщина находится в одном ___ с ним.
cases.translation: That dreadful woman is in the same city as him.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» expressing location governs the Prepositional case: «в городе».

reading.ru: Графиня Лидия Ивановна, очень молодою восторженную девушкой, была выдана замуж за богатого, знатного, добродушнейшего и распутнейшего весельчака.
reading.question: Who did the young, enthusiastic Lidia Ivanovna marry?
options: A rich, noble, good-natured, and dissolute man of pleasure
reading.correct: A rich, noble, good-natured, and dissolute man of pleasure
reading.explain: As a very young, enthusiastic girl, she was married off to a rich, noble, extremely good-natured but extremely dissolute man of pleasure.

reading.ru: На второй месяц муж бросил ее, и на восторженное ее уверение в нежности отвечал только насмешкой и даже враждебностью
reading.question: How did her husband treat her after abandoning her in the second month of marriage?
reading.explain: Her husband left her in the second month and responded to her enthusiastic protestations of tenderness only with mockery and even hostility.

reading.ru: Была влюблена в одного журналиста, в трех славян, в комиссарова, в одного министра, одного доктора, одного английского миссионера и в Каренина.
reading.question: Besides Karenin, who else had Lidia Ivanovna fallen in love with, among others listed?
options: A journalist, three Slavs, Komissarov, a minister, a doctor, and an English missionary
Only members of the royal family
reading.correct: A journalist, three Slavs, Komissarov, a minister, a doctor, and an English missionary
reading.explain: The text lists a journalist, three Slavs, Komissarov, a minister, a doctor, an English missionary, and Karenin among her infatuations.

reading.ru: она почувствовала, что все остальные любви не настоящие, а что она истинно влюблена теперь в одного Каренина.
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna realize about her feelings for Karenin compared to her other infatuations?
options: That all her other loves were not real, and she was truly in love only with Karenin now
That she had never really loved anyone, including Karenin
That Karenin's feelings for her were just as strong
That she needed to stop caring for Karenin
reading.correct: That all her other loves were not real, and she was truly in love only with Karenin now
reading.explain: She felt that all her other infatuations were not genuine, and that she was now truly in love with Karenin alone.

reading.ru: Она узнала, что Анна с Воронским в Петербурге.
reading.question: What alarming news did Lidia Ivanovna learn?
options: That Anna was in Petersburg with Vronsky
That Anna had left the country
That Anna had reconciled with Karenin
That Vronsky had been transferred abroad
reading.correct: That Anna was in Petersburg with Vronsky
reading.explain: She learned that Anna was in Petersburg with Vronsky, which threw her into great agitation.

reading.question: Whose handwriting did Lidia Ivanovna recognize with horror on the note she received?
reading.explain: The handwriting on the note, which she recognized with horror, was Anna Karenina's.

reading.ru: Конверт был из толстой как лубок бумаги, но продолговатой желтой бумаги была огромная монограмма, и от письма пахло прекрасно.
reading.question: What did the envelope from Anna look like and smell like?
options: Thick cardboard-like paper with a huge monogram, and it smelled wonderful
Plain white paper with no scent
reading.correct: Thick cardboard-like paper with a huge monogram, and it smelled wonderful
reading.explain: The envelope was of thick, cardboard-like paper with a huge monogram, and the letter smelled wonderful.

reading.ru: Я несчастна от разлуки с сыном. Я умоляю о позволении видеть его один раз пред моим отъездом.
reading.question: What did Anna ask for in her letter to Lidia Ivanovna?
options: Permission to see her son once before her departure
reading.correct: Permission to see her son once before her departure
reading.explain: Anna wrote that she was unhappy over the separation from her son and begged for permission to see him once before she left.

reading.ru: Все в этом письме раздражило графиню Лидию Ивановну.
reading.question: How did Lidia Ivanovna react to Anna's letter overall?
options: Everything in the letter irritated her
She felt deep sympathy and wept
She found it touching and wise
reading.correct: Everything in the letter irritated her
reading.explain: The text says everything in the letter irritated Countess Lidia Ivanovna.

reading.ru: «Скажи, что ответа не будет», сказала графиня Лидия Ивановна, и тотчас, открыв бювар, написала Алексею Александровичу, что надеется видеть его в первом часу на поздравлении во дворце.
reading.question: What did Lidia Ivanovna instruct about a reply to Anna, and what did she do immediately afterward?
options: She said there would be no answer, and immediately wrote to Alexei Alexandrovich
She dictated a long reply to Anna
She asked Karenin to reply personally
She ignored the note completely and did nothing
reading.correct: She said there would be no answer, and immediately wrote to Alexei Alexandrovich
reading.explain: She said to tell the messenger there would be no answer, and at once wrote to Alexei Alexandrovich.

reading.ru: Он налагает крест, он дает и силы.
reading.question: What religious idea did Lidia Ivanovna add to prepare Karenin for their meeting?
options: That He (God) lays the cross and also gives strength
That fate is unavoidable and must be accepted quietly
That patience is a virtue taught by the church
That suffering purifies the soul over time
reading.correct: That He (God) lays the cross and also gives strength
reading.explain: She added that He lays the cross but also gives strength, in order to prepare him somewhat.

reading.ru: Графиня Лидия Ивановна писала обыкновенно по две и по три записки в день Алексею Александровичу.
reading.question: How often did Lidia Ivanovna typically write notes to Karenin?
options: Two or three notes a day
reading.correct: Two or three notes a day
reading.explain: The text says Countess Lidia Ivanovna usually wrote two or three notes a day to Alexei Alexandrovich.
